messages:
Alex (Sales): AcmeFin POC tomorrow. They want BYO HSM + auto failover. Need clarity on: latency during failover, egress billing, rotation without downtime, and POC credits. Can SRE/security/pricing weigh in?
Sam (Security): Quick Q: do they require in-HSM signing ops or only key-wrapping? If signing is required we need attestation artifacts and FIPS level. Also need their custodian policy (# of custodians) for rotation playbook.
Jordan (SRE): Ops note: expect added p99 latency ~150-450ms on failover depending on inter-region RTT and KV cache coldness. With persistent KV cache and warm connections we see p99 ~120-200ms. Test plan: 100 RPS burst, ~80-token responses, simulate primary HSM tail and compare cold vs warmed prefix cache.
Leah (Solutions): I'll own the POC checklist + canary rollout (5% -> 25% -> 100%). Need sample API call, throughput targets, and attestation certs.
Alex (Sales): Customer sample BYO call they used: curl -X POST 'https://api.redwood.example/v1/generate' -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' -H 'X-CMK-IDENTIFIER: projects/acme/keys/customer-hsm-1' -d 'prompt=foo&max_tokens=64'
Priya (Pricing): BYO-HSM proxy pricing (POC): $1,200/mo base reserved proxy + ~$0.30 per 1k HSM egress ops (we can credit first month). SLA for failover <500ms would be premium. I'll DM a formal quote.
Jordan (SRE): For internal tests add header 'X-Redwood-Force-Failover: true' and capture per-request token timing in traces. Rotation suggestion (zero-downtime): 1) import new key to HSM, 2) add as secondary in proxy, 3) atomically flip routing pointer via rollout API, 4) ramp and monitor, 5) retire old key after TTL. Example: curl -X POST 'https://ops.redwood.internal/rollout' -d 'route=cmk-proxy&weights=primary:0.0,secondary:1.0'
Leah (Solutions): Draft runbook/timeline: Wed internal dry run, Thu customer session (30m), Fri validation. Priya, can you join Thu for pricing brief?
Priya (Pricing): Yep, I'll join and bring a reserved vs metered POC sheet.
Sam (Security): I'll review attestation docs after Leah shares runbook. Also confirm whether rotation is triggered by Redwood or the customer's custodian UI (affects audit events).
Alex (Sales): Customer says rotation will be custodian-initiated from their KMS UI. Leah: include 'custodian-initiated rotation' section and log schema (event id, timestamp, initiator).
Rosa (Legal): If they request key escrow we need escrow clauses and a statement that Redwood never holds plaintext keys unless explicitly agreed. Also confirm audit-log export and retention window (fintechs often request 7 years).
Alex (Sales): If we can get quote + runbook by EOD I can lock Wed/Thu slots with the customer. Thanks all :thumbsup:
Sam (Security): +1, standing by to sign off once attestation PDF is uploaded.
Rosa (Legal): Flagged potential escrow language; will follow up after runbook is uploaded.
Leah (Solutions): I'll upload the draft runbook and test vectors by EOD.
